diagnosis.detail: Every declared fixture used Tolarian Terror as the sole opposing creature. Tolarian Terror has Ward {2}. The two-land fixture pays Snap's {1}{U} and does not qualify or pay the intervening Ward {2}, so the spell does not reach the declared post-bounce land-selection continuation.

successor_rule: Preserve this original.
